description: This file contains functions for masking and unmasking parts of markdown text, including inline code, links, URLs, and placeholders. It is likely used to process documentation or markdown content within a larger project.

methods.name: maskMarkdown
methods.description: Masks inline code, links, and URLs in markdown text by replacing them with placeholders and storing the mappings.

methods.name: maskMatches
methods.description: Finds matches of a given regex in text and replaces them with placeholders, updating the mapping.

methods.name: maskLinkURLs
methods.description: Finds URLs within markdown links and replaces them with placeholders, updating the mapping.

methods.name: unmaskMarkdown
methods.description: Reverts placeholders in text back to their original markdown content using the saved mappings.

methods.name: validatePlaceholders
methods.description: Ensures that all placeholders are present in the given text.
